verdict.rationale: New Relic collects APM data through language agents and OpenTelemetry, plus infrastructure telemetry and logs, all queryable through NRQL in one platform. Its APM agents add metadata to forwarded logs so you get "logs in context" across the platform, tied to events, errors and traces, which is the shared-context pivot the story asks for. A community report confirms automatic log collection is on by default; a past logging-agent bug reflects reliability concerns, not absence of the capability. Missing for 10: dedicated distributed-tracing documentation, explicit evidence of pivoting from metrics or traces to logs in the UI, and independent hands-on corroboration of the cross-signal correlation workflow.
